head: 171354cd3135fd1dca0c072fd5c9c17f0333f544
reasons: plan.md Order of work step 1 has a wrong expected value in a planned test: it says `count_pairs([5, 50], [10, 50]) == (1, 3)`, but under R5 (and the plan's own `bisect.bisect_right(slows, fast)` per fast) the grid is (5,10) kept, (5,50) kept, (50,10) skipped, (50,50) skipped, so the answer is (2, 2). A correct count_pairs fails this test. A build that writes the test first, as the plan says, would either bend count_pairs to match, which breaks the skip count in the run line and the 400-pair cap, or change the expectation on its own. Fix: expect (2, 2), or keep (1, 3) with inputs that give it, e.g. `count_pairs([10, 50], [5, 20]) == (1, 3)`.
classification_reasons: Spec is tight (every open question answered, acceptance measurable), but the blast radius is not small: a new module (app/backtest/sweep.py) plus a refactor of the existing `run` sub-command's argument and output code into shared helpers in app/backtest/__main__.py.
The new behaviour (grid parsing, skip counting, cap, ranking, table layout) has no existing test coverage. The existing tests/test_backtest_cli.py only pins `run` through the refactor.
No risk-list item, no schema, no data-layer or public-API (`__all__`) change.
attempted: Intent: checked each intent outcome (command shape, shared args, list parsing and dedup, skipped pairs counted, single load, row contents, sort with ties, output lines, refusals incl. cap 400 counted after the order skip, every-pair-skipped range, offline tests, run unchanged, no new public name, CLAUDE.md lines for the owner) against R1-R15 and the Design. All are covered. The run line wording '9 pairs tried, 0 skipped' differs from the sketch, which the intent explicitly leaves to the design. OK.

Spec and plan: every requirement maps to a Proof test; open questions are answered with the intent's recommendations; the one flagged concern (argparse reading `--fast -5,10` as an option) is closed with a decision (accept argparse's exit 2, test with `--fast=-5,10`). Files that change: sweep.py, __main__.py, the new test file, plan.md. Nothing outside app/backtest or tests is touched.

Plan arithmetic: `count_pairs([5,10,20],[30,50,100]) == (9,0)` is correct. `count_pairs([5,50],[10,50]) == (1,3)` is wrong (correct is (2,2)): this is the reason above. `--fast 2,3,5 --slow 5,8,12,24` on 24 candles: 11 kept, 1 order skip, 3 candle skips, so 8 tried and 4 skipped, which works with the boundary `s < frame.height` (matches run's `frame.height <= slow`). 21x21 grid `1..21` by `22..42` = 441 > 400, correct. The defaults on the 24-candle day skip all 9 by candle count, so the R8 refusal follows. The synthetic 120 hourly candles from 2026-09-28 fill exactly 09-28..10-02, so `9 pairs tried, 0 skipped` follows.

Proof: design phase, no toolchain logs expected. The Proof list names 16 tests in a new file. The refusal tests assert empty stdout, one error line and `kucoin.calls == []`, mirroring test_backtest_cli.py's assert_refused. The 'loaded once' test also monkeypatches `app.backtest.__main__.load_klines`, which works because `_load` resolves the module global.

Blast radius: the only caller of __main__.py is `python -m`. The `run` refactor is pinned by the unchanged tests/test_backtest_cli.py (exact stdout lines, the 22-character width, refusals) plus a new option-order help test. `__all__` is unchanged, so test_public_api passes. No guardrail file is in the diff (the diff is the change folder only). CLAUDE.md drift is named for the owner in plan.md. No risk-list item applies.

Policies: security-baseline rule 2 (input size bounded by the cap, computed by bisect before the grid is built; no eval or shell; the only network call is load_klines's existing one). Coding-standards (type hints, new test module per area). ux-and-brand (each error says what to pass, copy in module constants). data-conventions correctly not applicable.

Tests: the tie test uses constant closes (no position ever, so total_return exactly 0.0 from START_EQUITY), which makes the fast/slow tiebreak observable. Row equality is computed independently through load_klines(cache=False), sma_cross_positions and run_backtest, so a wrong formatter or a wrong pair would fail. Hand-built frames match inputs.REQUIRED_COLUMNS (open_time, open, close), as in test_strategies._frame. This is a feature change, and no existing test is edited.
Skip markers: not applicable at design (the ratchets check runs at build/test). The plan declares none.

Claims against today's code, checked in app/backtest/__main__.py: `_length(text, name)` exists and gives `{name} {text!r} is not a whole number of at least 1`; `_fee`, `_percent`, `SMA_NOTE`, `RUN_HELP` exist; main catches InvalidRequestError, KlineGapError, DownloadError, BacktestInputError -> 2 and OSError -> 2 with the cache-dir hint; run's option order is --market, --fast, --slow, --fee, --cache-dir; buy and hold is `run_backtest(frame, [1] * frame.height, fee=fee)` printed as `{label:<14}{value:>8}`; run refuses `frame.height <= slow`; make_request(..., today) uses loader.utc_now().date(). strategy.validate_lengths' wording `{name} {length!r} is not a whole number of at least 1` gives 'slow 0 ...' for ints as R4 says. STRATEGY_NAME is 'sma-cross'. Summary fields total_return, max_drawdown, trade_count, win_rate and time_in_market are used by run. tests/kucoin_stub.py has KuCoin.calls, add_spot_synthetic(start, count, interval_ms) and SPOT_1H (24 candles per test_backtest_cli). tests/conftest.py's clock fixture sets loader.utc_now to NOW 2026-10-03 12:00 UTC. All of these match. docs/decisions/index.md does not exist, and the spec cites no decision.

Flagged concern detail: the spec's aside that `run --fast -5` is read as an option 'on some versions' is weak: '-5' matches argparse's negative-number pattern, so run receives it as a value. The '-5,10' list form is the one argparse rejects. The decision taken (test with `--fast=-5,10`) is still sound, so this is not a reason.
Drive: not applicable at design; commands.drive is not referenced by the plan.
